dataset_manifest.tokenizer: GPT-2 byte-level BPE; CR/LF removed; line EOS; no prefix space, BOS or truncation

source_dataset.export: UTF-8 text rows; append LF only when absent; empty rows become blank lines

summary.scope: fixed stream probe; interventions start from the normal trajectory
summary.window_state: S0 at window start, followed by warmup

gate_statistics.scope: equally weighted measured segments and examples; no training-time history

representations.scope: per-state slot x feature SVD; squared singular values define energy ranks; actual_update=S_next-S, context centering is per slot over observations
representations.cka_scope: same segment/example observations, centered per slot; constant=null; finite-sample bias, especially observations<features; no independent-sample claim

interventions.scope: positive=NLL intervention minus normal; reset to learned S0 or cyclic donor stream; fixed masks across windows; individual/group effects are not additive; recovery=all altered NLL minus only complement altered NLL; random range is a descriptive range, not a confidence interval; starts/lags overlap and are not independent samples

protocol.window_state: Reset to learned S0 at each start, then equal warmup
protocol.masks: Defined only on calibration; fixed for every window
protocol.damage_curve: Nested random subsets per repeat; ceil(fraction*M)
protocol.uncertainty: Raw paired example/start/lag deltas; no iid token confidence interval
protocol.scope: Gate categories are observations, not established functional roles

interpretation.gate_scope: Per-example gates on the fixed validation probe; not training trajectories
interpretation.slot_scope: Reset one slot to learned initial S0; contributions are not additive
interpretation.retention_scope: Swap once, then propagate the altered branch; lag0=current segment
interpretation.attention_scope: Write pooling attention is not token-to-register read attention
